title: Push the De Giorgi boundary through the graph chart: −∫_B⟨Φ_ω, ν⟩ = ∫_{M′} ξ′(ω) with M′ rectifiable of finite measure and ξ′ unit orientations (supplied steps 3–4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, x ∈ ℝ^P, ι : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P a linear isometry with adjoint ι*, u : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P, δ₁ > 0 and δ₂ ∈ ℝ. Write D := B_{δ₁}(0) ⊆ ℝ^{n+1}, G(v) := x + ιv + u(v), DG(v) for the derivative of G at v, e_0, …, e_n for the standard basis of ℝ^{n+1}, j.succAbove for the increasing enumeration of {0, …, n} ∖ {j}, and Z₀ := {w ∈ ℝ^P : |ι*(w − x)| < δ₁/2 and |w − x − ιι*(w − x)| < δ₂}. Assume u is C¹ on D and u(v) ⊥ range ι, |u(v)| < δ₂ for every v ∈ D. Let B ⊆ D be Borel and countably n-rectifiable with H^n(B ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, and let ν : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^{n+1} be Borel with |ν| = 1 on B and such that, for H^n-a.e. y ∈ B, (span{ν(y)})^⊥ is the approximate tangent space of B at y. Then there are a Borel, countably n-rectifiable set M′ ⊆ Z₀ with H^n(M′) < ∞ and a map ξ′ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) that is H^n⌞M′-a.e. strongly measurable and, for H^n-a.e. w ∈ M′, a unit orientation of some subspace, such that for every n-form ω on ℝ^P with tsupport ω ⊆ Z₀: −∫_B ⟨Φ_ω(v), ν(v)⟩ dH^n(v) = ∫_{M′} ξ′(w)(ω(w)) dH^n(w), where Φ_ω(v) := Σ_{j=0}^{n} (−1)^j ω(G(v))(DG(v)e_{j.succAbove 0}, …, DG(v)e_{j.succAbove(n−1)})·e_j for v ∈ D and Φ_ω(v) := 0 for v ∉ D.
